banner: REPLAY MODE - AGENT-VALIDATION RESULTS. Scripted SDK messages were run through the real PulseOps agent code. This does NOT measure real Claude model quality.
notes: Replay validates PulseOps' own grounding, validation, tool-boundary and fail-closed logic.
Scripted 'model' output is authored in the dataset; it says nothing about how Claude would answer.
Timings are informational and never gated. In replay mode 'investigation_ms' measures the scripted replay through the real agent code, not model latency.

telemetry.note: Replay does NOT measure Claude/model quality. Latency is harness/replay latency, not model inference latency. Tokens, cost and model are not reported in replay (the model is a script).

details: OBSERVATION: get_service_dependencies is a same-environment heuristic in the graph projection, not real dependency data.

OBSERVATION: KNOWN DEVIATION (pinned, not fixed in Gate 8): DEPENDS_ON edges are only generated for services that have a repository mapping, so the unmapped svc-ledger reports no dependencies while the mapped svc-payment reports svc-ledger. The same-environment heuristic is asymmetric and undocumented.
